prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one independent transparent PNG projectile VFX for the existing 2D Silent Hill: Halo of Flesh fighting game. Create ONLY the yellowish poisonous acidic MIST sprayed from the chest of the Lying Figure in the original Silent Hill 2 (2001), not the remake and not the film. It is a compact pale ochre / dirty yellow translucent spray of very fine liquid droplets and wispy vapor, expelled horizontally toward the RIGHT; narrow diffuse trailing origin at left, modest wider ragged dispersal at right. One continuous effect, viewed perfectly from the SIDE in the same horizontal plane as the 2D fight. The original has a sickly yellow mist, not luminous green sludge: no orb, no slime ball, no puddle, no gelatinous chunks, no magical ring. Make it textured and legible as high quality painted raster game art with subtle realistic volumetric translucency, clean antialiasing and granular edges. The cloud occupies roughly the central 70% width and 35% height of a landscape 1536x1024 canvas, whole shape contained with wide fully transparent margins. Genuine transparent alpha background and translucent vapor; nothing behind it, no shadow, no dark or white rectangle, no checkerboard baked in. No character, no creature, no person, no stage, no weapon, no impact target, no blood, no text, no UI, no logos. Exactly ONE VFX image, not a spritesheet, not panels. This is an authored side-view adaptation of a documented poisonous mist, not a claim to reproduce an extracted original texture.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one independent transparent PNG electric projectile VFX for a 2D Silent Hill fighting game. Create ONLY one short blue lightning discharge corresponding to the blue lightning attack of Incubator in the original Silent Hill (1999). Shape: an irregular thin jagged blue-white electrical filament, branching sparsely into 2-3 weaker short offshoots, travelling horizontally from LEFT to RIGHT. The bolt is a compact violent arc with a white-blue core, cobalt/cyan edge and a small controlled translucent blue bloom. Side-on 2D combat view, no perspective, no source character and no target. Preserve the simple angular late-1990s game-effect character while giving this raster asset clear high resolution edge detail. Not a round orb, not a beam cylinder, not a sci-fi laser, not a ball of electricity, not a huge lightning tree. ONE isolated effect occupying the central 75% width and 35% height of a landscape 1536x1024 image. Whole discharge inside the canvas with generous transparent margin; all glow fades to fully transparent alpha. Transparent background, no ground, no environment, no black or white backdrop, no baked checkerboard, no UI, no lettering, no logos. This is one static frame representing the documented blue discharge for the existing versus adaptation, no new gameplay power.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE independent transparent PNG ground-fire projectile VFX for the existing Silent Hill 3 (2003) God boss attack in a 2D fighting game. Depict ONLY a small low travelling patch of red-orange and amber fire that crawls along a flat ground line toward the RIGHT: a narrow bright yellow-orange base close to an invisible level floor, four or five ragged connected tongues rising briefly upward and bending slightly LEFT as it moves right, red outer fringes fading to transparency. Source behavior is the original God boss sending trails of fire across the floor, not a floating fireball or magical explosion. Side-on camera, readable dark horror-game palette, detailed painterly raster flames with modest translucent edges, no cartoon black outline. Keep the fire low, longer than tall, roughly 70% canvas width and 35% canvas height, horizontal base at 72% canvas height. Landscape 1536x1024, whole flame contained within canvas with fully transparent margin all around. Only the connected flame patch, no visible floor, no stones, no ash heap, no fuel, no cast shadow, no character, no creature, no environment, no text, no UI, no logos, no multiple panels or sprite sheet. Genuine transparent alpha backdrop. One static candidate frame for the existing ground-fire attack, no explosion, no body parts.
